help.stdout:
usage: gnd uninstall [-h] [--claude] [--codex] [--global | --project]

Remove every skill file GND placed at the requested target roots. A file is
deleted only when its bytes still hash to what the install receipt recorded,
so anything you edited is KEPT and named in the report — there is deliberately
no flag that overrides this. Files GND never placed are never touched. The
directories emptied by the removal are pruned and the receipt is removed last.
Unlike `doctor`, this acts on exactly the scope you name. Exits 0 on a clean
removal, 10 when something was kept, 12 when nothing is installed, 74 when a
receipt could not be trusted (in which case nothing at all was deleted). Text
output only (D-25).

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --claude    target Claude Code's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --codex     target Codex CLI's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --global    user level (DEFAULT): ~/.claude/skills and $CODEX_HOME/skills
              (~/.codex/skills)
  --project   this project: ./.claude/skills and ./.codex/skills
